# Sarah

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P54](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0054)</sub>
- **Family:** [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black clothing.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

## Personality

Sarah's primary ambition is to marry Luther Wallace.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063)_

## Goals

- wants to get married to Luther Wallace  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063)</sub>

## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah was courted by Luther Wallace, whom she liked, but her father sent him away because he was poor. Years later, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally fell through the roof of Sarah's duck house while trying to look into her pantry window. After releasing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from the roof, Sarah served tea to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and agreed to sell them a willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), +2 more_
